status: Assistant audit, pending independent human review; examples are not a measured error rate

cases.finding: The tracker assigns an active record to the city manager with uncertainty=null from an authorization recommendation. It nevertheless answers all three draft QA probes correctly.
cases.evidence_issue: The exact quote Motion carries resolves to characters 0-14, before Next item and the WIOA recommendation. That occurrence concerns the preceding item. A later noisy passage also reports a motion outcome, but the selected quote and saved offset do not point to it.
cases.implication: Exact quotation matching and downstream QA accuracy do not establish semantically correct commitment records. Review record status and evidence attachment separately.

cases.finding: The transcript states that the chair will sign the passed bill. The generated summary and tracker omit this role-based future action, and both miss the owner probe. The transcript condition answers it correctly. The reference summary describes the ordinance but omits all three probed details.
cases.implication: A substantive summary and a structured ledger can both drop a brief procedural commitment. This is one illustrative case, not an estimated omission rate.

cases.finding: The tracker retains furlough availability but omits the September-eight return of the elected-official item and the promise to return to public comment after the technical problem is fixed. It misses both probes; the generated summary and transcript answer both correctly.
cases.implication: A structured schema does not ensure recall of distinct tasks, dates, or procedural dependencies.

cases.finding: The generated summary describes the allocation and the successful vote but omits the explicit approval prerequisite as a condition of making funds available. It misses the condition probe, which the tracker answers correctly.
cases.implication: This is a local benefit of the tracker, alongside the cases where it loses information. Net real-pilot QA is still 21/24 for the tracker versus 22/24 for the generated summary.
